steps.title: Define Project Identity
steps.description: Establish package com.datetimeonly.app and app name 'DateTime Only' at the project level.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build System
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with proper compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, minSdkVersion 21 and compiler compatibility with Java 1.8.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest Properties
steps.description: Set up application nodes, point launch activity to MainActivity, and configure screen and orientation modes.

steps.title: Create Color Palette Settings
steps.description: Set up initial theme colors for full compatibility with default Android system colors.

steps.title: Implement Elegant Minimalist Layout
steps.description: Formulate a clean activity_main.xml layout highlighting oversized time text, AM/PM indicators, structured dates, and helpful interaction labels.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Populate strings.xml with standard UI text resources to maintain localizability.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Initialization
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java, inheriting directly from android.app.Activity, mapping layout elements cleanly.

steps.title: Implement Live Handler and Runnable
steps.description: Write update handlers running every 250 milliseconds to keep the clock precise and high performance without draining resources on standby.

steps.title: Create Format Toggles
steps.description: Configure tap listeners so users can cycle through multiple standard time formats (12h, 24h, with or without seconds) and date representation styles.

steps.title: Integrate Beautiful Desktop Themes
steps.description: Implement long-press logic to switch fluidly between high-contrast themes (Midnight Black, Deep Blue, Amber Clock, and Minimal White) with full color adaptation.

steps.title: Enable Always-On Mode
steps.description: Set system flags to keep the device screen on during execution, ideal for a desk or nightstand clock environment.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Verify that all implementations use anonymous inner classes, containing zero streams, lambdas, or modern SDK limitations.

steps.title: Building DateTime Only
steps.description: Verify build integrity, execute assembly compilation tasks, and package debug binaries.
